title: Spikers' Turf: NU pulls off upset of Criss Cross to open semis
summary: National University completed a sensational upset of Criss Cross to open its semifinals campaign in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Monday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
